symptom: The restored frontend source failed its production build with TS6133 and TS5097.
evidence: The bounded build output identified an unused React hook import and a .tsx extension in an application import.

root_cause.summary: The restored source did not satisfy the committed strict TypeScript and Vite configuration.

actions: Changed the App import to extensionless ESM resolution.
reusable_resolution: Keep React imports used and use extensionless local TypeScript imports under the committed Vite configuration.
prevention: Validate the sanitized source baseline with the permitted frontend production build before freezing it.
